findings.text: The spawn guard's new before_attempt rule at :2330 (and its skip_ended rule at :2332) is not covered by an assertion that fails if either is removed or inverted. tests/test_a_concurrent_launch_is_refused.py:429 plants a reservation at a LATER attempt than the spec, which is refused with or without before_attempt, and no fixture leaves a reservation at an attempt that also has an attempt-N-exit.json record, so the earlier-attempt admission and the ended-attempt skip this commit exists to provide are exercised by nothing. Reverting either line leaves the file green.

The head gate log named in the manifest has no '# revision' or '# command' header and ends '[exited with code 0]' instead of a bare EXIT= line, which the plan's done-when requires of every gate log; a reader cannot tie its 55-passed result to a revision from the log itself, and promotion's own reading of the exit status has to fall back on other fields.

negative_control_log names logs/repair-controls.log, which arms the previous round's commits at d656bc354b, while the controls that arm this round's changes are in logs/repair-3-controls.log, named only in negative_control_note; a promotion that reads the field would verify a control that never touches 227b1e5580..b1d5997119.
